query.query_text: Explain why investigate was routed to standard_review for debtor_account.other_id. Candidate entity type organization. Input ACME-OPERATING-001. Watchlist value ACME-OPERATING-001.

citations.title: Transaction Screening Policy
citations.excerpt: A supporting-evidence field cannot independently escalate a case. Exact dates, addresses, countries, and configured account identifiers may corroborate a candidate but remain secondary evidence unless linked to a qualifying candidate-alert match.

citations.title: Transaction Screening Policy
citations.excerpt: When a candidate entity type is incompatible with the screened ISO 20022 field, the case remains investigate unless an independently qualifying primary identifier resolves the conflict. The blocker entity_type_conflict prevents escalation while the conflict remains unresolved.

citations.title: Transaction Screening Policy
citations.excerpt: An exact LEI or exact BIC on a candidate-alert field may support escalation when the score threshold is met and no escalation blocker remains.

citations.title: Transaction Screening Policy
citations.excerpt: The deterministic policy engine owns the clear, investigate, and escalate disposition. Retrieved material and generated analyst notes provide context only and must not change the authoritative decision or review route.

citations.title: Screening Review Guidance
citations.locator: section:Screening Review Guidance > Wrong-field and entity-type review#block:1
citations.excerpt: Reviewers should compare the semantic role of the payment field with the watchlist entity type. A vessel name retrieved from a party-name field is not automatically a true match; the analyst should verify whether the field permits vessel candidates and document the conflict.
